name: clip_download_begin
description: Render one edited clip in the background. ReadOnly/Edit. WAV PCM16 stereo 48kHz or silent H.264 MP4; black sequence canvas, Full/Half/Quarter. Clip-relative range, at most 30s/64MiB. inspectDisabled ignores enable/mute only. Poll status then read bounded base64 chunks. No paths or raw source access.

startTicks.description: Signed Int64 decimal string; range checked by the typed decoder.

name: clip_download_status
description: Read render state and verified file metadata. Edits, document/path changes and source changes invalidate the download; expires after 10 idle minutes.

name: clip_download_read
description: Read actual bytes from a ready download, at most 131072 bytes per call. Verify chunkSha256, assemble offsets, verify metadata sizeBytes/sha256, save fileName. Audio analysis depends on client/model audio support.

offset.description: Signed Int64 decimal string; range checked by the typed decoder.

name: clip_download_cancel
description: Cancel/release an owned temporary download without changing project/history.
